# AI Ecommerce Workflow

AI Ecommerce Workflow is an evidence-first Agent Skill for public ecommerce market research, platform-specific listing drafts, and marketplace image requirements.

## Start

- Repository: https://github.com/mianbaofang/ai-ecommerce-workflow
- Canonical Skill: https://github.com/mianbaofang/ai-ecommerce-workflow/blob/main/SKILL.md
- English overview: https://mianbaofang.github.io/ai-ecommerce-workflow/
- Chinese overview: https://mianbaofang.github.io/ai-ecommerce-workflow/index-zh.html

Provide a product description, public product URL, or product image. The first output is a one-page public-market brief. Select a marketplace before requesting platform-specific copy, image requirements, or an optional image brief.

## Supported Scope

- Public comparable-product discovery, observed display-price context, and source-state evidence ledgers.
- Platform adapters for Taobao/Tmall, JD, Pinduoduo, Douyin, Kuaishou, Amazon, eBay, Etsy, Shopify, and AliExpress.
- A ten-platform image-requirement matrix and fact, category, claim, and marketplace-field review.

## Boundaries

- No catalog crawling, login-only data, access-control bypass, provider auto-installation, or seller-backend publishing.
- No fake reviews, invented product facts, certifications, transaction prices, platform approval, ranking, conversion, or sales guarantees.
- Generated image outputs are drafts and require human fidelity, rights, and marketplace review.
